description: Twins-style low birth weight mortality study
name: Twins
reference: Almond et al. (2005), NBER Working Paper
data_origin: SYNTHETIC - generated from scratch using formula-based twin pair simulation
what_is_real: Study design (twin pairs with intra-pair comparison), treatment definition (birth weight < 2500g), outcome (first-year mortality), ATE range (~0.05-0.08 from literature)
what_is_synthetic: ALL numerical data: maternal age ~U(15,45), gestation ~N(38,2), birth weight ~N(2000,300), mortality from logit model
note: SYNTHETIC DATA. No actual NCHS twin data is included.
known_issue: Generated treatment and outcome are constant in this version; retained only as negative QC control, not for ATE/CATE training.
